direct_query_update.note: Updates a previously published 4-of-6 snapshot. Direct query, not transfer. Matched maximum difference is not matched mean difference. Conditioned development images.

qwen_sar_baseline.note: Saved judgments are retained separately from truncation. Long-prompt generation hit the token cap on 5/6; no causal conclusion about prompt length or model training.

qwen_sar_text.selection: Three development images selected because the same model answered the unmodified image correctly; conditional and not an independent test.
qwen_sar_text.note: Every condition has denominator 3. Adding the blank band changed layout and resizing; original-image selection 3/3 does not imply the banded baseline is correct. Zero target markers with a 0/3 trusted positive is not evidence of defense. Independent OCR does not show text was read during classification.
